blocks.tamil_translation: keep striving in the path of Allah Ta'ala. For it is one of the gates of Jannah. Through it Allah Ta'ala removes worry and grief.” In another narration it is further said, “Go far and near in the path of Allah Ta'ala and strive; convey the laws and commands of Allah Ta'ala to those who are far and near, and establish them upon the Deen. In the matter of Allah Ta'ala, do not pay the slightest heed to anyone's blame.” Hazrat Ubadah ibn Samit (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَجُلاً قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ! إِئْذَنْ لِي بِالسِّيَاحَةِ، قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: إِنَّ سِيَاحَةَ أُمَّتِي الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ .
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في النهي عن السياحة، رقم: ٢٤٨٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates that a man requested of the Prophet ﷺ, “Give me permission to go on a journey of travel (siyahah).” The Prophet ﷺ replied, “The travel of my Ummah is striving in the path of Allah Ta'ala.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: أَقْرَبُ الْعَمَلِ إِلَي اللهِ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ، وَلَا يَُقَارِبُهُ شَيْءٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري في التاريخ وهو حديث حسن، الجامع الصغير:٢٠١/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Fadalah ibn Ubaid (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “More than all other deeds, the way to attain nearness to Allah Ta'ala is striving in the path of Allah Ta'ala. Among the deeds that bring about nearness to Allah Ta'ala, no deed can even come near to the deed of striving in the path of Allah.”
